items.name: Research Ration
items.description: A handmade test ration for the VTT Research Lab. No special rules.

effects.name: Research Marker
effects.description: A manual laboratory effect: add 2 to Strength while enabled. Hit points are unchanged. Leave suspended after the test.

spells.name: Research Spark
spells.description: A laboratory-only spell for inspecting fields. All damage and healing require a separate manual decision; do not apply automatically.

unsupported.name: pact
unsupported.reason: Only ordinary spell1..spell9 slots are mapped; pact/other resources remain source-only.

issues.message: Configured enabled flag and native metadata retained; darkness thresholds, shaders and level-specific activation are not evaluated by the bridge.
Foundry document coordinates retained. Padding, shift, background transforms and hex measurement rules are not applied.

Level IDs, names, elevation boundaries and native texture/visibility metadata are extracted. Entity level IDs are copied when present. No flattening, transform evaluation, occlusion, asset fetching or inferred membership is performed.
Dim/bright radii converted using grid distance. Cone, rotation, attenuation, animation, darkness, elevation and wall interaction remain source-only.
Center = top-left + grid size * cell dimensions / 2. Texture anchor/shape, elevation physics, animation, display modes and rotation artwork are not rendered; native metadata remains inert.

Normalized rangePixels describes sight WITHOUT a light source; null means native unlimited. Whole sight=null means unknown configuration. Range 0 is not blind or infinite. Light perception, mode, detection and occlusion require a compatible consumer.
Bar bindings/display modes are retained as metadata. Only explicitly supported Actor/local HP is normalized; other resources need a system adapter.
Import policy is GM-only. Source user IDs, disposition and visibility never grant destination ownership.
Listed sourceOnlyPaths are retained byte-for-byte in provenance but have no normalized behavior.
HTML converted to plain text; tags, attributes, active fragments and layout are not rendered. Exact original remains archived.
/items/1/system/uses/max: only canonical nonnegative integer literals are supported, never formulas; normalized uses omitted, no default counter or formula evaluation.
/items/2/system/quantity: expected finite number (booleans are not numbers); inventory mapping omitted. Separate Spell/Activity normalization may still apply; raw source remains archived.
HTML extracted as inert plain text; original tags/attributes remain archived.
Effect duration is metadata only. Start time/combat and automatic expiry are not evaluated; consumer enable/disable is manual.

Only unconditional initial-phase base-ability constant addition is normalized. Source ability scores remain unchanged; consumers compute derived values separately. Visual metadata and native change IDs remain source-only.
Missing current/capacity stays null. Capacity is only an explicit source override, never a class-derived guess.
